name: auto-route
description: Routes Claude Code by the ask: a routing table and agents for subagent work, and simple questions moved to Haiku or Sonnet.

haikuUpTo.title: Chat questions on Haiku
haikuUpTo.description: A plain question (not about code) runs on Haiku while the session context is under this many tokens, only from a session on a dearer model. 0 (default) turns it off: the switch is not measured yet. Above 100000 Haiku costs more than a warm Opus cache.

sonnetUpTo.title: Technical questions on Sonnet
sonnetUpTo.description: A technical question that asks for no change runs on Sonnet (only from an Opus or Fable session) while the session context is under this many tokens. 0 turns it off. The first switch writes the whole context to Sonnet's cache, so in a long session it costs more than staying on Opus.

houseRules.title: House rules
houseRules.description: on adds short rules to the main session's prompt: answer first, repo hygiene, a CHANGELOG entry and HANDOFF.md update per task, and a done-check before a build's last message. Off by default.
